messages:
Fern: quick idea: add an "impact heatmap" to the autofallback preview so operators can scan risk vs reward at a glance. shows latency, cost, and quality change ranges. thoughts?
Diego: love the heatmap concept. UI: three-axis mini-grid (latency delta, cost delta, traffic pct). color the cells by risk score. :art: 
Amira: make sure the quality delta is a range and linked to the eval webhook results. we can't promise absolute numbers, only estimates. show confidence band.
Clara: UX should let you click any cell to expand a tiny timeline + sample diffs for that bucket. keep samples redacted and capped at 3.
Fern: also want an explicit "why this request fell back" button on a request trace that opens the audit entry and highlights which trigger fired. small copy: "Fell back due to p95 spike & 5xx burst (policy afb-2100308642)"
Diego: ops-bot should auto-post a short human line when fallback engages: include event id and link. ops-bot: autofallback afb-2100308642 engaged by Fern. audit://afb-2100308642
Amira: safety gates: add SLA-aware rule: if fallback would violate customer SLA (e.g., route to slower model), composer warns and requires explicit opt-in. default is deny for SLA-bound routes.
Clara: on rollback: add an "auto-rollback window" option that watches a quality metric (eval webhook) for N minutes and rollbacks if regression > threshold. must record the trigger in audit and notify staff.
Fern: sample compact policy for the preview payload (backend will normalize):
```
{"id":"afb-2100308642","triggers":[{"type":"p95","op":">","value":600}],"mode":"soft-sample","sample_rate":0.05,"ttl_s":3600,"rollback":{"enabled":true,"metric":"quality_delta","threshold":-0.02,"window_s":900}}
```
Diego: need compatibility checks too (api shape, token budget). composer should show a single compatibility badge that expands to details. block enable if severe mismatch.
Amira: privacy: default redact=true for samples; add an "authorize-unredacted" flow for on-call with approval and 2FA. log who viewed unredacted.
Clara: telemetry: every decision should produce one event linking policy, preflight_snapshot, reservation_id (if any), and trace ids for first N requests. exported CSV should include counts and pct in fallback.
Fern: nice. final ask: the heatmap legend should include a short blurb about estimation method and a link to docs. i'll prototype the mock and drop it in the design thread. can @Diego and @Amira review later today?
Diego: will review at 2pm PT.
Amira: I can review after the audit schema PR lands.
Fern: thanks all
